description: Production-grade `dotnet new` templates for a .NET 10 Web API on Clean Architecture, DDD and CQRS: Domain, Application, Infrastructure and Api projects with the dependency rule enforced by architecture tests, a MediatR-free in-process dispatcher with a five-stage behaviour pipeline, transactional in-process domain events, Result/Error mapped to RFC 9457 ProblemDetails, JWT auth with refresh tokens, device sessions and permission-based RBAC, PostgreSQL via EF Core, Redis cache, S3/MinIO storage, SignalR, Quartz, Serilog and OpenTelemetry — plus unit, integration and NetArchTest architecture tests.
title: Clean Architecture Web API Templates for .NET
